governance: Additions require an original-source liturgical witness; mismatched Latin incipit disables the contextual reader. No date-only or transferred-feast guess.
importantNotes: Trinity Sunday: Missale Online labels Romans 11:32–36; the Latin incipit starts Romans 11:33. The corrected 11:33–36 is independently corroborated by https://mylatinmass.com/readings/trinity-sunday/.

Annunciation: Missale Online labels Isaiah 7:11–15; its supplied Latin begins at Isaiah 7:10. The corrected 7:10–15 is independently corroborated by https://mylatinmass.com/readings/annunciation-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary/.

Sacred Heart: Epistle uses Ephesians 3:8–12 and 3:14–19, not one continuous passage. It is excluded from the historical single-range index; the independently source- and Latin-matched segmented Proper index now supplies it.

Palm Sunday: Mass Epistle remains in the single-range Proper index. The pre-procession Gospel Matthew 21:1–9 belongs only to the native Palm rite and is not UI-linked. The Mass Passion Matthew 26:36–75; 27:1–60 is source-matched in the segmented Proper index, not to the procession Gospel.
Christmas has three distinct Mass forms, not a blanket Christmas-day reading. A single generic reading would be wrong.
Good Friday and Easter Vigil have distinct, non-Ordinary source-order graphs and are excluded from this Ordinary Mass Proper supplement.
The separately governed Good Friday and Easter Vigil owners must receive Scripture context from their own approved rite-state references; no proxy link to Palm Sunday or Easter Sunday is accepted.
Holy Tuesday and Wednesday Passions are cross-chapter readings: Mark 14:32–72; 15:1–46 and Luke 22:39–71; 23:1–53. Neither can be projected into the one-chapter Scripture Context reference parser.

Holy Wednesday first lesson's source heading says Isaiah 63:1–7, but the Latin begins with Isaiah 62:11 (Dicite filiae Sion); this is explicitly held pending segmented native lesson linking. The second lesson is Isaiah 53:1–12 and must retain its separate source-order identity.
Holy Thursday's Mass Gospel John 13:1–15 is not a proxy for the optional Mandatum and its separate associated chants.

Holy Tuesday's Gospel Passion Mark 14:32–72; 15:1–46 is excluded from this legacy single-range supplement, but available in the independently witnessed segmented Mass Proper index with a Latin-incpit and source-path guard.
